title: Sharper: Towards an Automated Verified Repair Tool for C# (TACAS 2027 Artifact)
description:
Artifact for the TACAS 2027 tool paper Sharper: Towards an Automated Verified Repair Tool for C#.

Sharper is a C# research prototype for trace-guided fault analysis and repair candidates. It uses Roslyn to inspect C# projects, records runtime traces, detects selected violations, propagates predicates, checks supported safety models with Z3, and validates repair candidates against tests.

The archive contains the tool source, five benchmarks (including the JsonConverter case study of Section 3), scripts to reproduce the evaluation natively on Windows (setup.ps1, run_quick_test.ps1, run_experiments.ps1) or in Docker (Dockerfile), and screen-recorded walkthroughs of the evaluation in videos/. See README.md for step-by-step instructions.
